purpose: Track migration source availability and explicitly accepted replacements. Original historical bytes for listed replacements are declared lost and are not claimed to be recovered.

recovered_sources.verification: Recovered source bytes recompute to the original Git blob SHA-1 and documented SHA-256. Database ledger records the full version but does not record a source checksum, so this proves artifact provenance, not an independent DB-side checksum of applied bytes.

replacements.reason: Historical source declared lost by project owner; accepted reconstructed equivalent is explicitly labelled and hash-pinned for future clean replay.
replacements.replay_gate: Requires clean replay and live-schema parity before release.
